programs.description: A mature resident baboon assists in uncovering the predator that brutally targeted many animals who attempted to quench their thirst at an oasis in Mana Pools National Park, Zimbabwe.
The filmmaker sheds light on how a famine turns into a feast for the insatiable predatory inhabitants of the Serengeti National Park when many animals visit the park during migration season.
